title: Medium’s new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process
slides: What if your writing app starts rewriting you?
Medium launches TK, an AI assistant inside the editor
It edits drafts, but may rewrite your voice entirely
Writers must now check every AI suggestion line by line
Next draft: let TK edit one paragraph, compare voices
thread_text:
1. Your editor just got opinions

Medium's new AI assistant TK doesn't just suggest commas — it rewrites drafts inside the editor. That means your voice is now a negotiation.

2. The rewrite gap

TK edits for flow, but flow isn't voice. It can smooth out quirks that made your writing yours, and you won't notice until the piece sounds like everyone else's.

3. Line-by-line tax

Every AI suggestion now costs you a read. What used to be a final pass is becoming a full editorial review of a machine's choices.

4. The comparison test

Let TK edit one paragraph, then read it against your original. The gap you hear is the part of your voice you'd be trading away.

5. Test it this week

Write your next draft without TK, then let it edit one section. If you can't tell which version is yours, that's your answer.

instagram.caption:
The app you write in can now rewrite your draft for you, sentence by sentence, right inside the editor.

Medium launched TK, an AI assistant that edits your drafts directly in the editor, adjusting flow and phrasing as you write. 🖊️

The catch: editing for flow isn't the same as preserving voice. TK can smooth away the quirks that make your writing yours, and you won't notice until the piece sounds like everyone else's. 😬

So every suggestion now costs you a line-by-line read, and your final pass becomes a full review of a machine's choices.

Let TK edit one paragraph of your next draft, then read it against your original. The gap you hear is what you'd be trading away. What do you hear? 👀
